assessment: Trypanosoma congolense is an important animal trypanosome that exhibits significant biological differences to the better studied Trypanosoma brucei. In this study, the authors describe a novel mouse model of cerebral trypanosomiasis, based on the 1/148 strain of T. congolense. Using elegant intravital imaging, the authors show that parasites sequester in the vessels of various organs, especially in the brain, causing deleterious T cell responses and inflammation.
